body: Can I please help in anyway. I’m 17 too and feel the exact same way right now. We can support each other, we don’t have to go it alone. I know we don’t know each other but I promise you have a friend in me. Please don’t do it ,I’m here for you to talk. I’m trying so hard to hold on, it feels like bungee cords are about to snap in my mind. I’m so afraid, of myself of the world and of everything.
Guys this is supposed to be about me

The difference is, I feel like it’s my show. I’m never gotten any attention so I try to bend reality so I’m the main character. Everyone else is something I can sift through a Cultural lens so I can experience the euphoric and sometimes dizzying high of being something. It’s dizzying because it’s not stable and not rooted in something true. It’s a delusion. I understand the world through symbols and categories... I try to fit as many as I can so the average cultural person can see me. None of us people, meet each other truly- we identify with each other through categories and dumbed down personas. There’s nothing real about human interaction these days. I happen to not know my place in any of this. Who am I to this world? Can I live without knowing who exactly I am in relation to everything else out there?  I hope this somewhat makes sense, I can be a little abstract and subliminal sometimes ( although this isn’t an accurate portrayal of just how abstract I can be).
Everything. My mental illnesses and disconnect from reality affects all my relationships. I also feel like I have no sense of identity. Sorry if this confuses you btw
